name: Welcome to GitHub Repos
description: An introduction to GitHub Repos: explore the directory, follow repository activity and statistics, suggest useful projects, and learn what this blog is for.

content.name: An introduction
paragraphs: Welcome to GitHub Repos. Here is a straightforward introduction to the website: what it is, what you can do with it, and how this blog fits in.

GitHub Repos is a curated directory of GitHub repositories covering development, automation, AI, infrastructure, and other fields. The idea is to make useful projects easier to find and give you enough context to decide which ones are worth exploring.

content.name: Explore the directory
paragraphs: The directory at /directory is the main place to browse repositories. You can search for a project or explore categories such as Development, Automation, AI, Infrastructure, Data, Security, Design, and Learning.

Open a repository's page to read more about it and review its available information before visiting the original project on GitHub. Whether you need a tool for your workflow or want to study how something was built, the directory gives you a starting point.

content.name: Follow the activity
paragraphs: The /activity page brings together recent additions to the directory, repository statistics, and development activity for this website. It is a way to check what has been added and what is changing without browsing the full directory again.

The /last-added-repos section shows the latest repositories added by contributors. The /last-commits section shows recent commits to the GitHub Repos project itself, so you can follow work on the website as well.

subsections.name: Repository statistics
paragraphs: Within the activity page, the /repository-stats section lets you compare stars and forks, along with their growth over the selected period. You can choose 24 hours, 7 days, or 30 days, filter by programming language, and sort by total count or growth.

These numbers provide another view of a repository's activity, but they are not a measure of whether it is right for your needs. Read the project's documentation, check its license, and review its maintenance before relying on it.

content.name: Add a repository
paragraphs: If you know a useful GitHub repository that is not in the directory, you can suggest it through /add-repository. This can be a project you maintain or one you have found helpful.

Submit the repository's GitHub URL and your name. You can also include an optional link for attribution. Every submission is reviewed before publishing, so submitting a repository does not add it to the directory immediately.

content.name: What this blog is for
paragraphs: The directory is for finding repositories. This blog is for the context around them and the website itself: project introductions, practical notes, feature explanations, and updates on GitHub Repos.
I plan to use it to explain changes and share things worth a closer look, with a focus on clear information that helps you make use of the website.

content.name: Part of the Nww Ecosystem
paragraphs: GitHub Repos is part of the Nww Ecosystem, a collection of websites for discovering tools, resources, creators, and communities. Each site has its own focus; this one is dedicated to GitHub repositories.

You can find the other sites at nekowawolf.xyz/ecosystem Here, you can start with the directory, check the activity page, or suggest a repository that deserves a place in the collection. Thanks for visiting.
